name: (Mana Wastes Mutant) Revolting Appearance
text: 60 feet. Details of the mutant's appearance are disturbing and unnatural in the extreme. A non-mutant living creature who begins their turn within 60 feet of the mutant must succeed at a Fortitude save or become Sickened 2. A creature who succeeds at its save is then temporarily immune to the aura for 24 hours.
